# Say “Yes” to more Construction Accounts


## **More Options for Your Construction Accounts**


##### Fast turnaround | Creative underwriting | 200+ target classes


A difficult loss history or specific coverage requirements can narrow your options, especially with a deadline approaching. You need underwriters who look closer, respond quickly, and work through the details. For example:


#### **A Major Loss. A Same-Day Quote.**


**OHIO • CRANE OPERATOR**


A crane fell on a building and the five-year incumbent non-renewed. Kinsale quoted the same day additional information arrived and coverage was secured three days before expiration.
**• Quick turnaround •**


#### **Specific Requirements. Customized Forms.**


**SOUTH CAROLINA • RESIDENTIAL FRAMING**


After receiving a quote, the broker requested older ISO additional insured forms on a blanket basis. We customized the forms to the insured’s requirements while keeping the premium below target.
**• Responsive service • Below target premium •**


[Explore More Construction Wins →](https://www.kinsaleins.com/hit-list-construction-wins/)


### **Service Doesn’t Stop With a Quote.**


From fine-tuning an initial quote to making midterm changes prompted by new contracts, our underwriters deliver the responsive support and tailored solutions you need to keep business moving.


**If you want to say “yes” to accounts with tight deadlines, special form requirements, or tough loss histories,** send them our way. We’re ready to put our speed, service, and expertise to work for you.
